repairs.quote: Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing (150/250/350 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) physical damage. Enemies in the center take (225/375/525 + (150% bonus Attack Damage) + (150% Ability Power)) physical damage instead and are Slowed by 40% for 2 seconds. Smolder's mom heals her son for (100/135/170 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (75% Ability Power)) Health if she hits him. Deals 50% damage to minions and monsters.
